name: Russian Affairs
description: Moscow, present day. The city of big money, passion, gorgeous women and wealthy men, receptions and dangerous intrigue. Dasha, an art historian from the province, who came to the capital, dreams of a new, better life, but a mysterious and cruel incident will change everything.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Gold and diamonds or blood and glass: what is the life of the Moscow elite like? New names appear on the list of kept women in the capital.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Mistresses can be a successful investment if you know how to properly manage your capital. But feelings sometimes interfere with reason.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: New life - new prospects. No one thinks about what is left behind when it comes to an ideal and almost achievable future.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: You can make any sacrifice for the sake of your loved one. What can the betrayal of loved ones push the heroes to?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Why limit yourself in funds if you have to spend someone else's capital? For the sake of success, you can sacrifice not only money, but also marriage.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Facts of betrayal come to light. Someone loses respect in society, someone thinks about divorce, and someone builds a career on this.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: How do you know that you are loved when you live among wolves? Selfish interest does not lead to anything good, but greedy predators forget about this.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Privileges or love? The choice seems obvious, but everyone has their own answer. And only a few manage to get everything at once.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The path to wealth is full of disappointments, but a comfortable life is worth it. Everyone who goes to her thinks so. What will the successful and famous say?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Another murder threatens to destroy the business and personal lives of the capital's oligarchs and give a new twist to the investigation of horrific cases.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Opening a business in Moscow is difficult, but if you have enough chutzpah, you can make it to the stars and stay on top of the world.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: While some are getting used to the life of a weak-willed kept woman, others are desperately trying to escape from meaningless relationships with former patrons.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: There is so much dirt on the Moscow elite that they themselves don’t know whether to hide it. But some secrets need to be kept to yourself.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Even a lion driven into a cage can break out of captivity and take revenge on its offenders. Will a predator awaken in Gleb?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The expression “honest cops” seems like an oxymoron to many. But myths, like immutable rules, sometimes collapse.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: While new names are being discovered in the world of art, old ones are forgotten in everyday life. The winner is the one who knows how to wait and keep secrets.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: It's time to find out all the secrets of the heroes and see the outcome of the story. Who will be the big fish and who will be the prey? The game has begun.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Not everyone knows how to separate personal and work. But in both cases you will have to choose a side, and also leverage.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The battle for a place at the top of the food chain continues. Sharks are swimming for fresh blood. And you never know whose mouth will be bigger.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Everyone can't wait to take theirs. Victory is the easiest thing. But what does it feel like to be left in the ashes?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: It is important not only to know who you are playing with, but also to bet on the right person. Experienced players act for sure: they choose themselves.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Money, love or freedom - each has its own price. But only those who leave the game on time will get theirs.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Underestimating women is a dangerous mistake. Just like believing that gaining time means being safe.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The end is near. Some flock together, while others prefer to swim alone. But the end is always the same. Either you ate it, or it ate you.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The heroes of secular Moscow are looking for profitable connections on the banks of the Neva. All the snakes are in one jar. And the lid will slam shut very soon.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The party will be remembered for a long time if it's with a murder. After the death of a person of this level, circles on the water are inevitable. Many will drown.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Everything collapses due to the death of Chistyakov. The business reputation of a sworn enemy, the future of a greedy widow and the filming of a film with her participation.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: If you want to find stolen property, look for the killer. Businesswoman Ilona Wagner is absorbed in her search and does not suspect that she is not the only one setting up a network.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Feast in Time of Plague. At Ilona Wagner's festival they walk like it's their last time. Sworn enemies and lovers let each other closer.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: What is more profitable - the death of your husband or the filming that he sponsored? Katya, like other predators, should take a closer look at businessman Hamid.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Lena Shirokova is looking for a nesting doll in exchange for her son's life. In the case of Chistyakov's murder, a thread appears that leads to a grandiose deception.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Negotiations are an art that has its connoisseurs. While important figures like Ilona and Olga measure their strength, the pawns do not stand still.
